kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 delete-app-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --delete-jobs true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAppGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the ID of the namespace on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the ID of the application on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the jobs in the application group. Valid values:

true: deletes the jobs in the application group.
false: does not delete the jobs in the application group
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除应用分组中的任务。取值如下：

true：删除。
false：不删除
parameters.name: delete_jobs
